description: Search Fursat's curated catalog of vacation homes in Northeast India and the Himalayas. Returns published homes with a Google rating of 4.3 or higher. Use this when a traveler asks about accommodation suggestions in this region (Meghalaya, Himachal, Uttarakhand, Sikkim, Assam, Arunachal Pradesh, etc.).

maxResults.description: Max results to return, default 10, capped at 20.

query.description: Free-text keywords matched against title, city, location (e.g., 'mountain view Cherrapunji', 'lake Nainital').

name: search_listings
